discourse.title: Do Constant Namasmarana for Mental Peace
discourse.excerpt: Whether a pauper or a millionaire, one has to eat. But, having attained the sacred human birth, it is unseemly of man to spend his entire life merely for the sake of filling his belly. Why don't you spend a few minutes in the contemplation of God, instead of spending your entire life just to earn a living?
discourse.theme: Constant remembrance of the Lord's name brings mental peace.

reflection: Swami looks at your life and asks a gentle question: you spend every hour filling your belly and building your career — but what about the few minutes that could fill your heart? You don't need a cave or a monastery. Just a few minutes with the Lord's name, repeated with love, can give you what money and position never will: a quiet mind. Begin today — 21 names, slowly, and feel the difference. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 37, 23 Aug 2004)
